name: Warden MCP
description: Remote MCP server for Warden Token Terminal: AI agents find trending tokens, search tokens, list chains, quote swaps and track swap status on Base, BNB Chain, Robinhood Chain and Arc without an account. Wallet and trading tools (get_wallet, agent_permissions, prepare_swap, execute_swap) need a free Warden account via OAuth or an agent key, within limits the user sets.
